purpose: Hero banner for the GitHub README of the open-source project "meshly"

project.name: meshly
project.description: A command-line tool that creates a private, encrypted, default-deny WireGuard link between exactly two Linux servers: a VPS in the cloud and a home server behind NAT.

format.fallback: if 3:1 is not available, use the widest landscape format and keep all important content inside the central horizontal band so the image can be cropped to 3:1
format.viewing_context: displayed about 880 px wide on GitHub, in both light and dark themes

style.rendering: polished digital illustration, soft bloom, high contrast, clean and modern, not cluttered

scene.background: deep space with a soft nebula and fine stars; a subtle perspective neon grid fading towards the horizon in the lower third
scene.left_node: a glowing node shaped like a compact server rack or small space station, labelled by nothing (no text)
scene.right_node: a matching glowing node on the right side, slightly different silhouette, also without text
scene.link: one single bright beam / tunnel of light connecting the two nodes, wrapped in a faint hexagonal shield pattern - the only path between them
scene.composition: symmetric; nodes near the left and right edges; logo in the exact center above the beam; generous dark empty margins around the logo

logo.mark: minimal geometric symbol: two small nodes joined by a link that subtly forms a lowercase "m" inside a hexagon outline, neon cyan to magenta gradient

wordmark.effect: crisp edges, slight neon glow, perfectly legible
wordmark.position: to the right of the mark, vertically centered

constraints.spelling: the only text in the image is exactly "meshly" - six lowercase letters, spelled m-e-s-h-l-y
avoid: any other text, tagline, labels or numbers
busy clutter or excessive lens flare
